subject: mathematics
concept: Reading and interpreting a line graph showing change over time
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student plots virtual points over time and connects them to see a trend form
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a pictured line graph and answers questions about increase/decrease over time
exercise.abstract: Student interprets trends (rising, falling, steady) and specific values from a line graph

misconception_flags: reads the wrong axis or misreads values between labeled gridlines

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
